info.title: Queue OpenAPI for speridlabs/idol
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the speridlabs/idol queue.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is generated.
seed.title: Seed

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checking of the input image.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance: how strictly the object follows the image.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

num_gaussians.description: Target number of Gaussians in the output splat. Rounded down to a multiple of 32.
num_gaussians.title: Num Gaussians

num_inference_steps.description: Number of sampling steps. Fewer are faster but lose some detail.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

image_url.description: URL of the image of a single object to convert into a 3D Gaussian splat.
image_url.title: Image Url

image_type.description: Kind of input image. `synthetic` for renders and generated images (tight crop), `real` for photographs (looser crop).
image_type.title: Image Type

preprocessed_image.description: The background-removed, cropped image the model saw.

model_glb.description: Colored point-cloud preview (.glb) of the splat centers, viewable in standard 3D model viewers.

camera.description: Predicted input camera: yaw, pitch (radians), radius, fov (degrees).
camera.title: Camera

num_gaussians.description: The actual number of Gaussians produced.
num_gaussians.title: Num Gaussians

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
